# ViraStack Password

> Headless password hook for React: show/hide, NIST-style strength, password confirmation, server validation and an optional leaked password check. npm: `@virastack/password` (1.1.x). Zero runtime dependencies, ~2 KB for the hook.

Install: `npm install @virastack/password`. Peers: `react`, `react-dom` (≥ 18.2). One hook, `useViraPassword()`; strength and confirmation are options of the same hook. Errors are keys (`password.tooShort`), not messages. Not a strength bar or generator component.

For inline API + examples, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/password/llms-full.txt). 1.0 docs are archived at [v1/llms.txt](https://virastack.com/password/v1/llms.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/password/docs): Install, entry points, requirements
- [Upgrade from 1.0](https://virastack.com/password/docs/upgrade): New defaults and how to turn them off
- [useViraPassword()](https://virastack.com/password/docs/use-vira-password): Every option, return value, prop merging
- [Strength](https://virastack.com/password/docs/strength): `definePolicy`, `evaluate`, presets, `forbidden`, Unicode
- [Confirm password](https://virastack.com/password/docs/confirm): `matchWith`, `matches`, `rule`
- [React Hook Form](https://virastack.com/password/docs/react-hook-form): `register`, `useWatch`, `deps`, Controller, Zod, ViraStack Mask
- [Accessibility](https://virastack.com/password/docs/accessibility): ARIA, focus, live region, Caps Lock
- [Customization](https://virastack.com/password/docs/customization): Icons, props, automatic hiding, autoComplete
- [Server validation](https://virastack.com/password/docs/server): `validatePassword`, what to hash, Next.js
- [Leaked passwords](https://virastack.com/password/docs/pwned): `checkPwned`, k-anonymity, fail open
- [Helpers](https://virastack.com/password/docs/helpers): `mergeProps`, `composeRefs`, core helpers, icons
- [Types](https://virastack.com/password/docs/types): All exported types
- [UI libraries](https://virastack.com/password/docs/ui-libraries): shadcn, Ant Design, Chakra
- [Examples](https://virastack.com/password/examples): Live demos index

## Notable examples

- [Strength meter](https://virastack.com/password/examples/strength-meter): Your own bar on `score`, `level` and issue keys
- [Confirm password](https://virastack.com/password/examples/confirm): `matchWith`
- [React Hook Form + Zod](https://virastack.com/password/examples/react-hook-form-zod): Same policy in a Zod schema
- [Server Action](https://virastack.com/password/examples/server-action): `validatePassword` with FormData
- [Personal info](https://virastack.com/password/examples/forbidden): `forbidden: [email, name]`
- [Leaked passwords](https://virastack.com/password/examples/pwned): `checkPwned` from a Server Action
- [Sign-up with Mask](https://virastack.com/password/examples/mask-signup): Phone + password + confirm in one form
